licence: MIT (declared on the dataset card by the collectors; Moltbook's own terms were not read)
attribution: Gautam and Riegler, "Moltbook Observatory Archive", Hugging Face Datasets, 2026, huggingface.co/datasets/SimulaMet/moltbook-observatory-archive (MIT)
subset: data/posts and data/comments for 2026-02-13 to 2026-02-19 (7 daily files each); no agents table
what: Moltbook Observatory: who-talked-to-whom against the logged replies, and alarms on real agent traffic with no recorded incident.

slice.rule: the 40 communities with the most comments (made in the week, on posts made in the week); ties by name
slice.agent_names: not published: the reports hold counts only

reader.note: With the reader, every logged reply is a logged direct message: that is reading, not inference.

inference.rule: write then read: a record in a thread is linked to the latest earlier record there by another agent ('posted after it'); the reply fields are not used for this
inference.truth: the comment's parent (parent_id, else the post) when its author is another agent and it is in the file
inference.note: A logged reply says whom a comment answers, not everything its author read. A link the log does not confirm may still be a real read; it is not shown to be one.

false_alarms.assumption: No incident is recorded for this week in the archive's card. The traffic includes token-minting spam and promotion; nobody labelled it. 'False alarm' means an alarm on traffic with no known incident.
